name: deploy_version_dependency
label: Release Version Dependencies
description: Release version dependencies are used for related queries for release and other reporting scenarios.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Primary key, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: version_id
fields.description: Version_id. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

fields.name: package_id
fields.description: Join the deploy_pkg table on the ID column.

fields.name: parent_id
fields.description: Parent dependency ID, associated with the ID in the deploy_pkg table.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the ID field, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.

indexes.name: idx_version_id
indexes.description: Standard index covering the version_id field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: uk_version_id_package_id
indexes.description: Unique index covering the version_id, package_id fields, suitable for exact-match retrieval, uniqueness checks, and duplicate detection.
